pricingTransparency.headline: How Pricing Works
pricingTransparency.intro: A low-minimum, USA-made production model with clear unit pricing and a flat design work-up fee.

bullets.text: Bulk pricing is often the standard model
Mold or setup costs may be separate
Final cost can vary by options and quantity
Clear unit pricing by product and quantity

pricingTransparency.note: The design and work-up fee is flat per custom design, not per item. Pricing tabs below show unit pricing and when the fee may be waived.

pricing.globalNote: Pricing is estimate based and subject to final artwork review. Custom requests may vary by size, detail, quantity, and production requirements.
pricing.designFeeNote: The $25 design work-up fee is flat per custom design, not per item. This covers reviewing the artwork, creating the custom coin layout, digital design work, preparing the files for production, making revisions as needed, and quality checking the final design before production begins. It may be waived for qualifying larger orders. Do not submit payment information through the quote form.

groups.name: Flexible Patch
groups.description: Custom flexible, durable, raised texture patch style products. These are not PVC patches and are not embroidered patches.

pricing.fee: Quoted by size, detail, backing, and quantity

groups.note: Small: 55mm. Medium: 65mm. Large/Replica Patch: Size depends on original patch being modeled. Oversized Flexible Patch style products require a custom quote.

groups.name: Challenge Coins
groups.description: Custom raised texture challenge coin style products for agencies, units, teams, events, supporters, and collectors.
groups.note: Challenge Coin style products are custom raised texture products with a 45 mm diameter. They are not described as metal coins unless approved later.
